question.prompt: The frequencies of the classes 0 to 10, 10 to 20, and 20 to 30 are 3, 5, and 2, respectively. What is the estimated mean of this data set using the class midpoints?

solutions.explanation: The class midpoints are 5, 15, and 25, respectively. The mean \(\approx(5\times3+15\times5+25\times2)\div10=140\div10=14\).
solutions.title: Frequency-weighted midpoint estimate
